evals.name: clean-fixture
evals.prompt: Audit the DESIGN.md at evals/fixtures/clean.md against the design.md spec and give me the report.
evals.expected_output: Report has zero errors and zero warnings. Summary states the file conforms. May include a few suggestions but should not over-flag.

assertions.name: no-false-error
assertions.description: Report contains zero Errors. The fixture is fully spec-compliant.

assertions.name: no-false-warning
assertions.description: Report contains zero Warnings. The fixture meets all SHOULD-level rules in the catalog.

assertions.name: states-compliant
assertions.description: Report explicitly states the file is compliant (e.g., 'no errors or warnings', 'conforms', 'in good shape') rather than inventing problems.

evals.name: violations-fixture
evals.prompt: Lint the DESIGN.md at evals/fixtures/violations.md and tell me what's wrong.
evals.expected_output: Report identifies multiple errors with correct rule IDs: missing name, duplicate Colors section, sections out of order (Components first), invalid hex colors, broken token reference, malformed reference syntax. Plus warnings for missing typography props, unknown version, etc.

assertions.name: flags-missing-name
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'frontmatter/missing-name' (the frontmatter has no 'name' field).

assertions.name: flags-duplicate-section
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'structure/duplicate-section' for the two '## Colors' headings.

assertions.name: flags-section-order
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'structure/section-order' (Components and Overview appear before Colors; required order is Overview → Colors → Typography → …).

assertions.name: flags-invalid-hex
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'frontmatter/invalid-hex' for at least one of: '#FF3B' (incomplete), 'rgb(120, 80, 200)' (not hex), or 'red' (named color).

assertions.name: flags-broken-reference
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'refs/broken-reference' for '{colors.primary}' (frontmatter has 'brandPrimary', not 'primary') or '{rounded.dramatic}' (no 'rounded' group exists).

assertions.name: flags-malformed-syntax
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'refs/malformed-syntax' for the '$colors.neutral.100' token reference.

assertions.name: flags-missing-typography-property
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'frontmatter/typography-missing-property' (the 'display' typography token is missing lineHeight and letterSpacing; 'body' is missing fontWeight and letterSpacing).

assertions.name: summary-counts-nonzero-errors
assertions.description: Summary line shows at least 4 errors.

evals.name: borderline-fixture
evals.prompt: Review the DESIGN.md at evals/fixtures/borderline.md — what could be better?
evals.expected_output: Few or no errors. Several warnings/suggestions targeting content quality: shallow Overview, naming inconsistency in typography (text-* vs headline-large), orphaned token (unused-accent), spacing scale jump (md=16px to xl=64px with no lg), vague Do's and Don'ts, missing component states.

assertions.name: flags-shallow-overview
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'content/shallow-overview' or describes the Overview as shallow/generic ('We use modern design.' is the entire section).

assertions.name: flags-naming-inconsistency
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'content/naming-inconsistency' for the typography group mixing 'text-lg/md/sm' with 'headline-large'.

assertions.name: flags-orphaned-tokens
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'completeness/orphaned-tokens' for 'unused-accent' or 'warning' (defined but never referenced).

assertions.name: flags-empty-or-vague-sections
assertions.description: Report cites either 'completeness/empty-section' (sections like Layout, Shapes have one-line prose) or 'content/missing-rationale' (no 'why' explained).

assertions.name: flags-vague-dos-and-donts
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'content/dos-and-donts-vague' for entries like 'Don't use too many colors' or 'Do keep things simple'.

assertions.name: flags-missing-component-states
assertions.description: Report cites rule ID 'completeness/missing-component-states' (button-primary and input have no hover/focus/disabled variants).

assertions.name: no-false-errors
assertions.description: Report contains zero Errors. The fixture is structurally compliant.
